ui_bugs.issue: Still shows '29+ CARS INDEXED' despite DB having 106 cars (flagged in iteration 2, NOT fixed). Should read '106+' or '100+'.

design_issues.screen: Compare / any page with Select dropdown
issues: React hydration error in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>.' — a Select component is rendering decorative <span> (likely an icon) inside native <option>. Likely Compare page car-select dropdown. Should move icon outside <option> or use shadcn Select with SelectItem instead of native <option>.

action_items: Fix Home '29+ CARS INDEXED' to '106+' (still stale from iteration 2).
Fix hydration error: <span> inside <option> in Select component (Compare page dropdown). Use a shadcn Select with SelectItem + inline icon OR strip span from native <option>.
[Optional] Consider adding a way to skip/shorten trial timer in dev/test builds — 180s trial is hard to automate end-to-end for lock-overlay testing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~620 lines — partners + bookings + AI all in one file. Recommend splitting into routers/partners.py, routers/bookings.py, routers/ai.py before it grows further.

_assign_partners_to_booking() always picks LOAN_PARTNERS[0] / INSURANCE_PARTNERS[0] — round-robin comment in code is aspirational, not implemented. Future commissions will pile up on HDFC/Bajaj Allianz only. Add a real round-robin using partner_leads count per partner.
/api/partners and /api/partners/leads have no auth — anyone can scrape commission pipeline and partner configuration. For CRM, at minimum require a shared admin token via env.
Commission math is silent (loan_amount = car_price * 0.85 hardcoded LTV; insurance premium_pct hardcoded per partner). OK for MVP, but document assumption in response so dealers can verify.
AI chat BOOKING_CONTEXT is injected via .replace() on the system prompt — if a booking field contains '{LANGUAGE}' or '{BOOKING_CONTEXT}' literally, substitution can go wrong. Use safe templating.
/api/ai/chat searches bookings by phone regex '\b(\d{10})\b' — correct; however, if no phone and no CRM keywords, falls through. Already guarded. Fine.
Showroom.jsx trial timer is client-only (not enforced server-side). A user can refresh or tamper localStorage to bypass. MVP-OK, but add server-side entitlement before real billing.

Frontend: every /cars card renders a full SVG silhouette (106 cards × multiple <svg>) → 538 SVGs in DOM on /cars page. Consider <use> + <symbol> sprite or lazy-render below the fold to reduce paint cost on low-end phones.
Booking still returns 200 (should be 201 Created) — flagged in iteration 2, not fixed.
No pydantic validator on phone in BookingRequest (flagged iteration 2, not fixed) — accepts any string.

rca_of_the_issue: Hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>': some native HTML <select>/<option> element has a nested <span> (likely a lucide icon rendered inside <option>). Most likely in Compare.jsx car-picker selects or a shared dropdown. Fix: either use shadcn Select/SelectItem which uses <div role=option> (accepts children), or strip icon span from <option>.
